high_level_description: This image depicts a stunning view of Earth from space during nighttime. The planet is illuminated by the glow of city lights, creating a vibrant and dynamic scene. The lighting highlights the intricate patterns of urban development, with bright clusters of light representing densely populated areas and smaller points of light indicating less populated regions. The sun is positioned just above the horizon, casting a warm, golden-orange hue across the upper part of the image.
